For White Elephant, Yankee Swap or a Secret Santa reveal.

A gift exchange goes wrong for reasons that have nothing to do with the

minutes. Somebody tears up a sheet of paper to make a turn order while
fourteen people watch. And it is over in nine minutes without having been

This fixes all three.

THE THREE SETS
HOUSE RULES — 10 cards laid out before anything is opened. Those are the
rules for tonight, on the table rather than in an argument. Pick the ones
that suit the room: a cautious office and a family that has done this for
fifteen years do not want the same game.
PASS & SWAP — 15 cards drawn during the game to move the gifts around. This
is what makes it a game rather than a queue.
WHO GOES NEXT — 15 cards, so nobody has to appoint anybody.
